title: 多智能体LLM协商中的隐藏锚点
summary: 本文建模多智能体LLM协商为闭环动力系统，每个智能体携带隐藏的内部信念（锚点），持续影响其观点。研究发现锚点可从协商中恢复，并解释为何智能体对正确答案的信心可能超越初始信念的凸包。通过检查恢复的锚点是否泛化到未参与运行的预测，可判断模型是否真正由锚点驱动。
summary_en: This paper models multi-agent LLM deliberation as a closed-loop dynamical system where each agent has a hidden internal belief (anchor) that continuously pulls its opinion. The anchor can be recovered from deliberation and explains why confidence in correct answers can exceed the convex hull of initial beliefs. A generalization test determines if a model is truly anchor-driven.
